meta.purpose: Frozen function-level expectations for the Infinite Tower web engine (v0.7), to verify a Godot/GDScript port against.

rng.name: mulberry32
rng.note: Each case swaps Math.random for mulberry32(case.seed) and restores it after. The engine has no other nondeterminism on these paths.

conventions: Case shape: {id, category, fn, seed, args, expect, note}. fn names a probe implemented in tests/golden.js; args are JSON-able.
Comparison is EXACT deep equality on the probe return value (numbers bit-identical; no tolerance).

Battles run through IT.combat.start(cfg) with FAST=true, headless (no DOM). Battle observables: returned result {win, retreated, deaths}, IT.combat.lastUsage, IT.combat.debug().lines (the rendered log, damage numbers embedded), and live hero objects in IT.S (hp/fear persist).
dmg entries are parsed log lines formatted "source>target=amount". dots = Burn tick amounts per holder. heals = heal amounts per target. match = occurrence counts of note-worthy substrings.

Engine consumes Math.random in a fixed order per battle (AI jitter first, then variance rolls); reproducing a case means reproducing that call order. Pure-arithmetic cases (rewards, exp, decide scores, makeEnemies, scout) need no RNG at all.

Test heroes are plain objects built with explicit stats/axes/trait/reaction/skills; test skills are data rows injected into IT.SKILLS using only documented spec fields (power/cd/ai/effects/condition/cost/target/type/executeBonus/prefer).
Rounding everywhere: Math.round (half-up on positives), damage floors at 1 via max(1, ...).
Battle cases run with IT.combat.REACTIONS = false (the engine test hook) unless args.reactions is true — the reaction-layer multipliers are stripped so frozen numbers isolate the system under test.
Regenerate expectations after an intentional rebalance with: node tests/golden.js --update

cases.note: IT.rnd(0.85,1.15) = 0.85 + u*(0.30), u = mulberry32 draws. This is the rawDmg variance term v. 8 draws frozen to 1e-6.
IT.ri(6,14) = floor(6 + u*9) — the fallen-item stat roller. Bounds 6..14; draws frozen.
Raw mulberry32(seed=101) unit interval draws — the PRNG curve itself. A port must reproduce these exactly to pass any seeded case.
rawDmg(atk=100, mult=1.0, def=0) = max(1, round(100*v - 0)), v=rnd(0.85,1.15) (2nd Math.random draw: 1st is pickSkill jitter). Enemy hp 120 needs 2 hits.
mult=0.75 with def 4: round(40*0.75*v - 4*0.6) = round(30v - 2.4). Strike-spec multiplier path.
def > atk floor: 5*0.75*v - 50*0.6 is deeply negative -> max(1, ...) = 1 every hit.
heavy def subtraction: round(100v - 24), always >= 61 at v=0.85.
mult=1.4 (Crushing Blow power): round(42v - 6).
multi-round variance sequence: damage per round round(100*v_k) plus incoming max(1, round(12*w_k)) until E1 (400hp) dies. Freezes the v-sequence, not just one draw.
seed chosen so the first damage draw v sits near its 0.85 lower bound -> dmg near 85 (variance lower extreme).
seed chosen so the first damage draw v sits near its 1.15 upper bound -> dmg near 115 (variance upper extreme).
computeEffective: eAtk=round(40+10+2)=52, eDef=15, eMax=120+20+30=170; item hp fills current hp to 170 at battle start. Self-cost skill logs round(eMax*0.15)=26; outgoing hits use eAtk 52.
control for eff-001 (no items): cost = round(120*0.15) = 18, damage from atk 40. Same seed -> same v draws.
incoming damage uses eDef: raw=round(60*v), taken=max(1, round(raw - 15*0.6)) with the armor (+5 def); outgoing unchanged at atk 40.
irongut: eMax = round(100*1.15) = 115, current hp raised to 115 at start. Self-cost = round(115*0.15) = 17 (17.25 -> 17). hpAfter shows the 115 pool minus cost/hits.
glassedge outgoing: eAtk = round(100*1.15) = 115 -> dmg = round(115*v).
control for trait-002 (no trait): dmg = round(100*v). Same seed -> identical v sequence; the ratio to trait-002 isolates the x1.15.
glassedge incoming: eDef = round(20*0.85) = 17 -> taken = max(1, round(60*v - 17*0.6)) = max(1, round(60v - 10.2)).
control for trait-004: taken = max(1, round(60v - 12)) with def 20.
bloodthirst: +10% dmg while any living enemy hp < 30% maxHp. R1 hits E2 (lowest): round(75v) wounds it under 30; R2 escalates to round(75*1.1*v). Later rounds track E1 dropping under 60/200 too.
control for trait-006 (no trait): identical targeting/seed, no x1.1 on the wounded-field rounds.
nighteyes on a DARKNESS floor (11): outgoing x1.10 -> round(100*1.1*v) = round(110v). Darkness also multiplies enemy atk by 1.1 at start (0 -> 0 here).
floor-band control: same DARKNESS band (12) without the trait -> plain round(100*v); isolates the nighteyes bonus vs trait-008.
nighteyes OUTSIDE the 11-13 band (floor 14, BLOOD MOON): no bonus -> round(100*v). Hero kept above 30% hp so Blood Moon never fires.
faintheart: -10% dmg dealt -> round(100*0.9*v) = round(90v).
faintheart withdrawal compliance: decide(retreat) for this hero scores 5 (refuse), but the trait forces compliance -> hero withdraws before round 1 ends, battle result retreated=true, deaths empty.
control for trait-012 (trait without the compliance hook): same refuse-score hero refuses the order, battle continues and is won.
coldblood under PANIC (fear 80 >= 75, courage 50 < 70): the 35% freeze never fires (0 frozen lines) but Panic -25% dmg still applies -> round(50*0.75*v) = round(37.5v).
control for trait-014, same seed: without coldblood the PANIC freeze lands at least once (a turn with no A attack line).
barrier 60% on the round it is applied (dur 1 covers the enemy phase to come): incoming raw = round(60*v*0.4), then def. Round 2 the barrier has decayed -> unreduced. Log tags "(barrier)".
100% barrier (Vanish spec): raw reduced to 0, but the final floor max(1, ...) still deals exactly 1. Engine truth: full barrier is not full immunity.
fragile (Berserk price): taken dmg x1.2 AFTER def subtraction -> round(raw*1.2). Log tags "(fragile)".
barrier + fragile stacked: raw = round(60*v*(1-0.5)), then d = round(raw*(1+0.2)). Both tags appear on the line. Order: barrier first (pre-def), fragile last (post-def).

DoT through barrier: burn dot = round(eAtk*0.5) = 20, then applyDot = max(1, round(20*0.5)) = 10 per tick. NOTE ENGINE TRUTH: hero-side burn never decays (tickHeroStatuses only decrements non-burn statuses), so it ticks every hero turn until battle end.
DoT through fragile: dot 20 amplified x1.2 -> 24 per tick (no def, no intercepts; hp floors still hold).
executeBonus via effects entry: R1 gA (ai 10 beats 5) leaves E1 under 30% of 120 (=36); R2 gA is on cd so gB fires with m = 1.0*(1+0.5) -> round(150*v), killing it.

executeBonus both regimes in one battle: E1 (1200hp) stays above the 30% line (360) for the first ~9 rounds — gB hits at plain round(100*v); once cumulative damage drops it under 360, gB escalates to round(150*v). Compare early vs late dmg values.
executeBonus via TOP-LEVEL spec number (the second documented encoding): identical outcome to exb-001 — both encodings must resolve to the same bonus.

Mend (spec power 1.6): heal = round((18 + eAtk*1.6 + lvl*2) * 1.6) = round((18+80+6)*1.6) = 166. NOTE ENGINE TRUTH: castSkill multiplies the whole base by spec.power, and the base itself already uses the 1.6 atk coefficient — effectively atk*2.56. Frozen as-is.
Mend cap: heal amount 166 but hp clamped to eMax -> healed = 100 exactly (hp 100 -> 200 of 200).
Mend scaling: round((18 + 20*1.6 + 10*2) * 1.6) = round(112) = 112. lvl term is +2/level, uncapped by eMax here.

F10 informed: boss cycle cleave(r1) -> MARK+dread(r2) -> EXECUTION(r3). Def 200 floors every boss hit at max(1,...)=1; Mend (knowExec retarget) tops the marked hero to full eMax before the axe -> execute FIZZLES: "finds no weakness" then axe dmg round(55+46*0.5*v) reduced by def. deaths empty. Headless start/mark interrupts resolve to choices[0] (focus/hold).
F10 blind (no knowledge, no healer): marked hero is 2 under max when the axe falls (r1 cleave + r2 dread deal 1 each through def) -> NOT full -> lethal execute: hp forced to 0, deaths [1], loss.

Hollow King cycle slash(r1) -> summon courtier(r2) -> DRAIN(r3, step%3==0): targets lowest-loyalty hero (L1=60); loyalty >= 60 resists -> raw = round(52*2.2*0.5*v) = round(57.2v). King then heals the hp actually drunk.
same setup, least-loyal hero at 40: NO resist -> raw = round(52*2.2*v) = round(114.4v), exactly double the resisted roll at equal v (modulo rounding).
boundary: loyalty 59 is one under the resist line — full-power drain. Pairs with hk-001 (60 = halved) to pin the >= 60 comparison.
cd 0 = spammable: castable every hero turn; lastUsage counts gs == number of hero turns fought (strike fallback never needed).
cd 1 locks exactly 1 turn: cast r1, strike r2, cast r3, strike r4... Engine sets cds=cd+1 on cast and decrements at every turn START (so ready again after exactly cd locked turns).
cd 2 locks exactly 2 turns: cast r1, strike r2+r3, cast r4... (Fireball/Meteor cadence).
cd 3 (Crushing Blow/Poisoned Blade cadence): cast r1, strike r2-r4, cast r5.

enemy-side burn: dot = round(eAtk*0.3) = 6 (RNG-free), ticks at the ENEMY turn start, dur decrements every enemy turn (burn included). cd 0 recasts stack: r2+ shows one line per stacked burn. dots.E1 sequence frozen.

atkup decay: applied r1 (no attack that turn — War Cry is a pure buff), active on r2 hit (x1.15: round(90*1.15*v)), decayed to 0 at the r3 turn start -> r3 hit unboosted. Same-round application never decays on the caster same turn.
taunt: every enemy attack line targets the taunt holder T while the status lives (dur 2), overriding the v0.2 tank-bias/pick targeting. All dmg lines read E*>T=...
stun (chance 1): enemy skips its turn every round ("reels — stunned"), taking one stun line per enemy turn until death. Hero takes zero damage — dmg has only A>E1 lines.
killer instinct: r1 leaves E1 under 15% of 35 (=5.25); r2 multiplies m by 1.5 -> round(30*1.5*v) = round(45v). Seed chosen so r1 damage >= 30.
steady control: every hit x1.05 -> round(31.5*v); no escalation on the wounded round. Same seed as rx-001.
Last Stand (courage 90 >= 85, hp 10 < 15%, ally 20 < 25%): triggers once; stander intercepts ALL enemy damage and floors at hp 1 (hpAfter.LS ends 1 while surviving), outgoing x1.5, 2 rounds.
Coward's Retreat: hp 15 < 20% of eMax -> 40%/turn slip-out roll happens BEFORE acting. Seed chosen so the r1 roll fires: hero withdraws keeping 15hp, single-hero party -> battle ends retreated.
Coward Retreat roll fails (seed chosen so u >= 0.40 on r1): hero attacks instead, kills E1 (20hp) before another roll — win, no withdrawal.
in-battle loyalty gate: loyalty 20 < 30 -> 20% per turn to refuse ("refuses the order"), losing the turn. Seed chosen for at least one refusal; fewer A>E1 dmg lines than rounds fought.
control: loyalty 50 never gated — 0 refusal lines, one dmg line per hero turn.
OVERDRIVE master command (once per battle): m x1.25 on rounds 1-2, burns off at end of r2 and adds fear +15 (fearAfter). r3+ damage back to x1.05 steady baseline.

PROTECT master command (2 rounds): every enemy blow is retargeted to the protector at FULL value with the protector def applying (taken = max(1, round(60v - 30*0.6))). All enemy dmg lines read E1>P1=...
legacy fallback path: skills resolving to nothing but strike -> kitFor returns null -> v0.2 hardcoded Warrior act (30% Power Strike x1.8, else x1.0). Freeze so un-migrated saves keep exact behavior.
score = round(clamp(50 + Σ axis*weight, 0, 100)); open_chest: +0.2c +0.5g -0.4f = 50+12+20-8 = 74 -> comply (>=60).
investigate: +0.4c +0.2g -0.5f = 50+24+8-10 = 72 -> comply.
help_stranger: +0.4c -0.3g +0.3l -0.2f = 50+24-12+16.5-4 = 74.5 -> Math.round after clamp -> 75 -> comply.
retreat: -0.5c +0.1l +0.4f = 50-30+5.5+8 = 33.5 -> 34 round -> refuse. This is the same table decideRetreat uses in combat.
upper clamp: raw score 120 -> clamped 100 before round -> 100, comply.
lower clamp: raw 50-50 = 0 -> refuse.
verdict band edges: score 50-10+5+16 = 61 -> comply; retreat score of exactly 60 is the band line (>=60 comply, 40-59 grudging, <40 refuse).
mid band: 50-20+5+10 = 45 -> grudging.

loyalty gate: loyalty 10 < 25 and action != retreat -> 30% flat-refuse override (verdict refuse + disloyal line pool). Seed chosen so the gate roll fires; score itself is ungated (91 -> comply without the gate).
gate does NOT fire (seed roll u >= 0.30): verdict follows the score -> comply.
alt branch: rob_stranger for this hero scores 50 + 0 - 60 = -10 -> clamp 0 -> refuse; with ctx.alt the 50% coin (first RNG draw) fires -> verdict "alt".
no alt offered: same refusing hero (score 0) stays refuse. Loyalty 100 >= 25 so the gate coin cannot fire — isolates the alt coin. Roll order in decide(): alt coin first, then loyalty gate.
expNeed(lvl) = 60 + 45*lvl.
104 exp at lvl 1 (need 105): no level — stats and hp untouched, exp 104 banked.
exactly 105: one level. maxHp=round(100*1.10)=110, atk=round(20*1.09)=22, def=round(10*1.06)=11, agi=round(8*1.03)+1=9, hp=min(110, 40+30)=70.
multi-level cascade: needs 105+150=255 (2 levels, 145 banked). Growth applies per level with rounding between levels (compounding round chain).
banked exp counts: 280+30=310 vs need(5)=285 -> one level, leftover 25; hp floors up via +30 heal to 33 of the new maxHp.
masterExpNeed(lvl) = 100*lvl.
250 exp at ML1: 100+150 -> 2 levels, 0 banked.
carried exp: 50+160=210 vs need(2)=200 -> ML3 with 10 banked (leftover carries across the level line).
unlock hooks at ML1: rosterCap 24, recruitCost 120, restMult 1.
ML2: roster cap 24->30 (deep tower unlock).
ML4: rest cost x0.6.
ML5: recruit 120->90.
floorClearGold(n) = 40+25n except F10=600; floorClearPermits: +1 on 3/6/9, F10=3.
deep tower: permits on 12/15/18; F20 gold 900, permits 4.
scoutCost(floor): 25, but 50 inside the DARKNESS band 11-13 (inclusive both ends). M.ScoutCost constant stays 25 for back-compat.
makeEnemies scaling: hp = round(40*(1+0.28(n-1))*m), atk = round(8*1.26scale*m), def = round(2*1.22scale*m), bounty = round((20+9n)*m); count 2 (n<=4) else 3; first is Elite (x1.5) from n>=6.
floors 9 and 19 bulge x1.1 on top of the elite x1.5; floors 11-19 use the deep-tower mob names.
boss rows: F10 THE EXECUTIONER (1300/46/10, bounty 200), F20 THE HOLLOW KING (2250/52/12, bounty 400) — fixed, no scaling.

rollRarity over 1000 seeded draws — empirical distribution vs the 55/28/13/4 table. Bounds documented: every count stays within binomial noise of its rate (sigma ~ 15 at n=1000 for p=.55). Frozen exactly.
second independent 5000-draw run (different seed) — a port matching mulberry32 + the cumulative threshold walk (<.55 ->1, <.83 ->2, <.96 ->3, else 4) reproduces both.
rollTrait: uniform index = floor(u*6) over TRAIT_IDS key order [irongut, glassedge, coldblood, bloodthirst, nighteyes, faintheart].

full recruit pipeline per hero (in RNG order): rarity roll, class pick, 4x stat variance rnd(.92,1.08) (hp/atk/def/agi), name pick, axes ri(20,90)/ri(10,90)/ri(50,90)/ri(5,30), trait roll; reaction derived from axes (precedence courage70/loyalty80/fear70/greed70/steady); personality from label(). RARITY_MULT {1:.82, 2:1, 3:1.25, 4:1.5}.
gacha economy: 2 permit recruits first, then gold at 120/hero until it cannot pay (250 -> 240 spent, 5th attempt returns null). Roster counts only successful recruits.
broke Master: no permits and less than recruitCost() gold -> null, roster stays 0.
rest: cost = ceil(missing*0.4*restMult) = ceil(60*0.4) = 24 gold; heals everyone to max, fear -25 clamped at 0 (A 30->5, B 10->0).
ML4 rest discount x0.6: ceil(60*0.4*0.6) = ceil(14.4) = 15. Fear 99 -> 74.
bond writes are symmetric, clamped -100..100 (40 then +30 -> 70, not 100 on write 1); reads mirror; bondedPairs needs >=60; mournersOf(dead) = living heroes with bond >=30 to the dead id.
personality precedence: courage>=70 Brave; fear>=70 Coward; greed>=70 Greedy; loyalty>=80 Loyal; greed>=60&&courage>=60 Reckless; fear<=30&&courage<=40 Cautious; else highest axis.
Reckless band: greed>=60 AND courage>=60.
Cautious band: fear<=30 AND courage<=40.
loyalty 90 but courage 50: falls through to highest-axis rule (loyalty 90 wins the fallback loop) — Loyal via fallback, not the >=80 shortcut (same word, different branch).
reactionFor precedence: courage>=70 wins over everything -> laststand.
courage under 70: loyalty>=80 -> protective (before fear and greed).
fear>=70 -> cowardretreat beats greed>=70.
greed>=70 -> killer; everything under the lines -> steady.
telemetry normalize: known counters floored to int, zero/negative dropped, unknown keys (schema drift) dropped; migrateToV7 stamps ver 7.
